name: Karona
description: A godlike being who summoned color gods and later heard a voice claiming to be Yawgmoth.

timeline.summary: Karona the False God claims to have met Teferi and found Phyrexia, a claim later proven false.
timeline.quote: it is thought that Karona had been delusional

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamhal's Soul Reaper slays Phage, Akroma and Zagorka, leading to the rebirth of Karona.
timeline.quote: leading Phage, Akroma, and Zagorka to all be slain by the attack.

citation.text: "Avatar", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl's Soul Reaper kills Akroma and Phage and accidentally Zagorka, their essences forming Karona.
timeline.quote: The essence of the three women blended into a new being

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Phage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona is destroyed at the climax of Karona's War, creating the Otarian rift.
timeline.quote: The last major rift to come into existence was created at the climax of Karona's War

citation.text: "Rift", section "Otarian rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During Karona's War Braids falls into fanaticism and is trapped in her own dementia space.
timeline.quote: ended up trapped in her own dementia space

citation.text: "Braids", section "Succumbing to Dementia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona is betrayed and killed by her minions Sash and Waistcoat, releasing Jeska, who becomes a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: killing Karona and releasing Jeska, who then became a planeswalker.

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Krosa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Mirari falls into Kamahl's hands, and his actions inadvertently lead to the Rebirth of Karona.
timeline.quote: saw it eventually falling into the hands of Kamahl , whose actions inadvertently led to the Rebirth of Karona

citation.text: "Rift Era", section "Rise and Fall of Karona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona's War triggers a final time rift formation across Otaria, and her brief reign ends in her destruction.
timeline.quote: Her brief, unstable reign ended in her destruction, but the damage to the plane's leylines was done.

citation.text: "Rift Era", section "Rise and Fall of Karona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona is created when three mother figures die; she destroys Otarian cities before being slain.
timeline.quote: a being called Karona was brought into being

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Coming of Karona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In a final battle between Phage and Akroma, the two and Zagorka merge to form Karona.
timeline.quote: the two beings and Zagorka merge to form Karona

citation.text: "Legions", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl arrives with Soul Reaper and Zagorka jumps from her tower, crashing onto Phage and Akroma as Soul Reaper falls and kills them all; the goddess Karona is born.
timeline.quote: From the combination of their three souls and bodies, and the magic of Soul Reaper, the goddess Karona is born.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl's Soul Reaper kills Akroma, Phage and Zagorka; Akroma dies in peace and Karona is born.
timeline.quote: Akroma finally died in peace, knowing that Ixidor had been avenged at last.

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Rebirth of Karona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the birth of Karona ends the Numena's rule, Averru creates a spell to resurrect himself as a giant city.
timeline.quote: Averru created a spell to resurrect himself as a giant city

citation.text: "Averru", section "Ancient Dominion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl's arrival during the battle between Akroma and Phage disrupts Averru's plans by triggering the rebirth of Karona.
timeline.quote: disrupted Averru's plans by triggering the Rebirth of Karona

citation.text: "Averru", section "Reawakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona encases the Numena in stone; Kuberr suffocates and Lowallyn is freed, then stomped to death by his own magma giant under Karona's control.
timeline.quote: Kuberr was left trapped inside too long and suffocated

citation.text: "Averru", section "Karona's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona blasts Averru with pure magic, destroying him and the city; the last numen dies.
timeline.quote: The city was destroyed, and the god with it.

citation.text: "Averru", section "Karona's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl swings the Soul Reaper in Sanctum, killing Phage, Akroma and Zagorka, whose merged souls become Karona.
timeline.quote: the axe claimed Phage and Akroma's lives, as well as an unexpected third life

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Rebirth of Karona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl meets Karona, then resolves she must be stopped; he retrieves the Mirari from Laquatus's corpse with Balthor's ghost's help.
timeline.quote: it was only through Balthor's spiritual sacrifice that Kamahl managed to gain control over the Mirari-sword

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Karona's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl and the numena confront Karona in Sanctum; Karona and the numena are killed.
timeline.quote: In a final confrontation, both Karona and the numena were killed.

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Karona's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Numena's conflict accidentally births Karona, and the Numena unite to destroy her after thirteen months at the cost of their power and lives.
timeline.quote: Karona existed for only thirteen months before the Numena managed to destroy her

citation.text: "Karona", section "Ancient Karona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Akroma, Phage and Zagorka are slain by Kamahl's Soul Reaper at the apex of their battle, and Karona is reborn from their fused bodies.
timeline.quote: wrought from the fused bodies of the three great women

citation.text: "Karona", section "Karona Reborn (c.4306 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona decides she must be a goddess, believing the praise she receives.
timeline.quote: Karona soon assumed that she must be a goddess

citation.text: "Karona", section "Karona Reborn (c.4306 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona summons five portals seeking her equal; Teferi, Lowallyn, Yawgmoth, Fiers and Multani come through, and Yawgmoth's words lead her to decide to destroy the gods.
timeline.quote: Karona summoned five portals to search for her equal

citation.text: "Karona", section "Karona Reborn (c.4306 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona's presence destroys the Grand Coliseum as her worshippers tear its foundation apart.
timeline.quote: her very presence led to the destruction of the Grand Coliseum

citation.text: "Karona", section "Karona Reborn (c.4306 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Above Averru, Karona is drawn by Arien and trapped by the three Numena; Kamahl stops their assault and has her banished.
timeline.quote: Kamahl chose to see her banished from their world instead

citation.text: "Karona", section "Karona Reborn (c.4306 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona emerges where the three Mothers had stood.
timeline.quote: "I am Karona," She spoke first.

citation.text: "Rebirth of Karona", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona opens portals seeking her equal, learns Gaea is the true World Soul, and falls into rage and madness, becoming a self-proclaimed goddess of magic.
timeline.quote: drove Karona to rage and madness

citation.text: "Rebirth of Karona", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phage and Akroma's war ends with their deaths and fusion into Karona, leaving Otaria torn by militant factions.
timeline.quote: With the vicious war between Phage and Akroma , and their followers, over with their deaths and fusion into Karona

citation.text: "Scourge", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The explosion that spawned Karona also gives birth to the Sliver Overlord.
timeline.quote: from the explosion that spawned Karona, the Sliver Overlord , a new leader of the slivers, controlling others via the hive mind, was born

citation.text: "Scourge", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl frees his sister Jeska from Karona and Phage.
timeline.quote: Kamahl frees his sister, Jeska , from both Karona and Phage

citation.text: "Scourge", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl's Soul Reaper fuses Akroma, Phage and Zagorka into the goddess Karona; the armies stop fighting to worship her.
timeline.quote: Kamahl's Soul Reaper has cut through Akroma , Phage , and Zagorka to fuse them into one being: the goddess Karona.

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl sees the carnage of Karona's worshipers and resolves that Otaria needs no goddess; he goes to Krosa for the Mirari sword.
timeline.quote: Kamahl sees the carnage and her callousness and resolves that Otaria needs no goddess.

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona finds Sash and Waistcoat and appoints them her prophets.
timeline.quote: She provides them with everything they need and appoints them to be her prophets

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona creates a chasm that swallows the rampaging armies, burying them, including Braids, alive.
timeline.quote: she creates a vast chasm underneath the armies that swallows them whole and then fills it again, burying them, including Braids, alive.

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona embraces her destiny as a goddess and builds an army to destroy those who oppose her.
timeline.quote: She decides to embrace her destiny as a goddess and builds an army of followers to destroy the few that oppose her.

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona annihilates the city of Aphetto while Lowallyn and Kamahl escape through a portal.
timeline.quote: just before she annihilates the city in the blink of an eye

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The three numena set a trap with Kamahl to seal Karona, but he stops it, allowing her to escape the plane.
timeline.quote: He stops the plan at the last moment, allowing Karona, with Sash and Waistcoat in tow, to escape the plane.

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona meets Lord Macht, warden of a metal world, who reveals the Mirari's nature; she realizes he is its creator.
timeline.quote: Karona is not fooled by his story and realizes that he is the creator and that he feels guilty about the Mirari.

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona returns with an army and overcomes the defenders at Averru, killing the numena and taking the Mirari sword.
timeline.quote: The numena are killed, and only Kamahl stands with the Mirari sword.

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sash and Waistcoat recover the blade and drive it through Karona on Lord Macht's instruction.
timeline.quote: Sash, and Waistcoat recover the blade and drive it through her

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lord Macht takes Karona to Argentum, where she regresses to Jeska, and reveals himself as Karn; he gives life to the Mirari to create a new warden and leaves with Jeska.
timeline.quote: he reveals himself to be none other than Karn , Urza 's golem

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In 4308 AR Karona, Sash and Waistcoat visit a recreated Realm where an angel calling herself Serra says she has been rebuilding it since the powerstone exploded.
timeline.quote: Serra had been working to rebuild the realm since then.

citation.text: "Serra's Realm", section "Recreation of Serra's Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona withdraws magic, freezing the forest for three months until Karona is killed by the Mirari-sword and it thaws.
timeline.quote: The forest thawed, and warmth returned.

citation.text: "Skyshroud Forest", section "Temporary loss of magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A century later Karona hears a disembodied voice claiming to be Yawgmoth in shattered Phyrexia but flees.
timeline.quote: There she met a disembodied voice claiming to be Yawgmoth

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "False demise?". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When Karona is killed the three women separate and Jeska's spark ignites, making her a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: the three women separated

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska shatters the image of Karona and closes all rifts in one discharge, allowing the Great Mending to begin.
timeline.quote: In one huge discharge of her power, she closed them all, allowing the Great Mending to begin.

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn turns the Mirari into the golem Memnarch, whose contact with Karn's glistening oil leads him to transform Argentum into Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: he decided to turn Argentum into Mirrodin

citation.text: "Karn", section "Argentum". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Blind Eternities Karona follows a path to a plane of yellow skies where locals reject her, and flees.
timeline.quote: Terrified, Karona fled by moving to another plane.

citation.text: "Karona", section "Karona in the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona and her disciples meet Serra, who tells her Dominaria is her true home.
timeline.quote: Serra's only advice was to remind Karona that she was Dominaria's magic

citation.text: "Karona", section "Karona in the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the remnants of Phyrexia Yawgmoth urges her to stay, but warned by Sash and Waistcoat, Karona leaves.
timeline.quote: Karona simply left.

citation.text: "Karona", section "Karona in the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On a metal plane Karona recognizes Lord Macht, forgives his guilt over the Mirari and is transported back to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: the grateful Lord Macht transported Karona back to Dominaria

citation.text: "Karona", section "Karona in the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona gathers an army and wages Karona's War across Otaria, destroying cities.
timeline.quote: Karona attempted to take over all of Otaria by gathering those who praised her into an army

citation.text: "Karona", section "Karona's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona kills the three Numena one by one and decrees Kamahl's death.
timeline.quote: She killed all three Numena one by one

citation.text: "Karona", section "Karona's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sash and Waistcoat pierce Karona with the Mirari Sword on Lord Macht's advice; Macht takes her to Argentum where she dies, regressing into the three women, with Jeska surviving.
timeline.quote: the two un-men, pierced Karona's belly with the Mirari Sword

citation.text: "Karona", section "Karona's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In 4308 Karona travels to Mercadia, meets the mechanical goblin Masters, and kills one who calls Gerrard a saboteur.
timeline.quote: Karona killed that Master and left.

citation.text: "Mercadia", section "Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona summons several people thought of as gods, Multani among them.
timeline.quote: The goddess Karona was looking for people similar to her and summoned several people thought of as gods, Multani among them.

citation.text: "Multani", section "100 years after the Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: They gain human bodies at the cost of Umbra's life and are healed by Karona, who takes them as disciples.
timeline.quote: so she took them as her disciples

citation.text: "Sash and Waistcoat", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sash concludes Karona is magic manifest and she tests her powers, which turn out to be based on faith.
timeline.quote: Sash concluded that Karona was magic manifest

citation.text: "Sash and Waistcoat", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona's War begins; Kamahl nearly loses fighting her.
timeline.quote: Kamahl came to bring an end to Karona's reign, but he almost lost the fight.

citation.text: "Sash and Waistcoat", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Lord Macht's advice, Sash and Waistcoat betray Karona and pierce her belly with the Mirari Sword; they survive and return to the Gilded Mage.
timeline.quote: pierced her belly with the Mirari Sword

citation.text: "Sash and Waistcoat", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Most slivers die in the explosion that created Karona; a small group fuses into the Sliver Overlord.
timeline.quote: However, a small group of slivers survived and fused into the ultimate manifestation of the hive mind, the Sliver Overlord .

citation.text: "Sliver", section "Riptide Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona turns her wrath on the world that birthed her.
timeline.quote: Tormented by her own existence, Karona turned her wrath on the world that had birthed her.

citation.text: Decimate (Dominaria Remastered, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After Karona's Rebirth and the First's death, the Boy rules Aphetto.
timeline.quote: Aphetto fell under the rule of a child known only as

citation.text: "Aphetto", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona brings her war and army to the canyon, saves 500 of 10,000 people and annihilates the rest, including the Boy.
timeline.quote: Karona saved 500 people from the population of 10,000

citation.text: "Aphetto", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sash and Waistcoat return with Elionoway, are arrested, and are freed by Karona's arrival.
timeline.quote: the arrival of Karona ensured that Sash and Waistcoat were freed and given honorable positions in the city

citation.text: "Eroshia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona's wandering leaves Eroshia in ruins, with hundreds trampled and thousands injured.
timeline.quote: From the Plains Gate to the harbor, Eroshia lay in ruins.

citation.text: "Eroshia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When Karona leaves Dominaria taking all magic, the cable cars and Sea Colossus collapse.
timeline.quote: The cable cars and the Sea Colossus collapsed, and the street lights all winked out.

citation.text: "Eroshia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona returns, makes Eroshia her base, forcibly recruits its people as her army and kills the 300 who refuse.
timeline.quote: She forcefully recruited the city's population as her army, minus 300 who refused, whom she killed.

citation.text: "Eroshia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Eroshian army takes part in the siege of Aphetto and then marches on Averru, where most are killed.
timeline.quote: The Eroshians then marched on to the city of Averru , where most of them were killed in the fighting.

citation.text: "Eroshia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona is killed by the Mirari-sword and her magic returns to the land and to Eroshia.
timeline.quote: When Karona was killed by the Mirari -sword, her magic returned to the land.

citation.text: "Eroshia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona summons Fiers and other figures, a meeting later retconned.
timeline.quote: While Karona summoned Fiers

citation.text: "Fiers", section "Scourge continuity issue". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona drains the area of mana, collapsing the arena and then annihilating the coliseum after Kuberr, Kamahl and Lowallyn escape.
timeline.quote: Karona proceeded to annihilate the rest of the coliseum in a rage, leaving nothing but a field of ashes behind.

citation.text: "Grand Coliseum", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kamahl kills the death wurm in Topos, freeing Ixidor and recruiting him against Karona.
timeline.quote: He found the death wurm in Topos and killed it, freeing Ixidor and recruiting him to his cause.

citation.text: "Ixidor", section "Karona's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ixidor is possessed by Lowallyn, who is killed by Karona in the final battle, ending Ixidor's life too.
timeline.quote: Lowallyn was killed in the final battle by Karona, thus also ending the life of Ixidor.

citation.text: "Ixidor", section "Karona's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona raises an army at Eroshia, and razes Aphetto and other cities.
timeline.quote: Aphetto was razed, leaving only a black crater behind

citation.text: "Karona's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The numena unite against Karona and are defeated one by one.
timeline.quote: Kuberr suffocated, imprisoned in stone.

citation.text: "Karona's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A stray thought from Kamahl empowers Karona to annihilate Averru's city and Averru; the last numen is dead.
timeline.quote: The last numen was dead.

citation.text: "Karona's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lord Macht tells Kamahl only the Mirari-sword can stand against Karona; Kamahl fights but is disarmed.
timeline.quote: Karona disarmed him and prepared to strike him down

citation.text: "Karona's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sash and Waistcoat, under Macht's instruction, pierce Karona with the Mirari-sword, ending her reign.
timeline.quote: they pierced her with the Mirari-sword, ending her reign and releasing all the magic back into the world

citation.text: "Karona's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Macht reveals himself as Karn and takes Karona's body to Argentum, where Jeska emerges as a Planeswalker.
timeline.quote: she was reborn not as a goddess but as a true Planeswalker

citation.text: "Karona's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Krosa's trees decay after Karona's apocalypse, but the druids remain, dedicated to Kamahl's memory.
timeline.quote: Krosa's trees decayed, leaving the forest a shadow of its former grandeur

citation.text: "Krosa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kuberr is killed, suffocating trapped in stone encased by Karona.
timeline.quote: Kuberr was left trapped inside too long and suffocated

citation.text: "Kuberr", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The birth of Karona causes the Fall of the Numena and Lowallyn's death.
timeline.quote: until the birth of Karona caused the Fall of the Numena and Lowallyn's death.

citation.text: "Lowallyn", section "Ancient Dominion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona traps the Numena in a block of stone and Kuberr suffocates.
timeline.quote: Kuberr was left trapped inside too long and suffocated.

citation.text: "Lowallyn", section "Karona's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona takes control of the magma giant Lowallyn made and has it stomp him to death.
timeline.quote: stomping Lowallyn to death with his massive burning foot

citation.text: "Lowallyn", section "Karona's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When Karona left the plane with her magic, the tomb's glyphs went dark and panthers massacred remaining visitors.
timeline.quote: There was a massacre in that darkness

citation.text: "Martyrs' Tomb", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona kills one of the Masters in Mercadia.
timeline.quote: Karona killed one of the Masters and left

citation.text: "Mercadia City", section "Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Stonebrow returns Soul Reaper to Kamahl, who cleaves Phage, Akroma and Zagorka to create Karona.
timeline.quote: thus creating the false god Karona

citation.text: "Stonebrow", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Stonebrow survives the Rebirth of Karona with two broken legs.
timeline.quote: he survived, albeit with two broken legs

citation.text: "Stonebrow", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Stonebrow joins the forces of Averru in the last battle against Karona's War and survives.
timeline.quote: joining in the last battle against Karona's War at that site

citation.text: "Stonebrow", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Akroma leaves to kill Phage, a battle that causes the Rebirth of Karona.
timeline.quote: Akroma marshaled her forces and left to kill Phage, a battle that caused the Rebirth of Karona .

citation.text: "Topos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When Karona takes all magic from Dominaria, Topos decays and returns to sand.
timeline.quote: All of Topos returned to the sands that had birthed it

citation.text: "Topos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: The Boy stood in defiance against Karona

citation.text: "Aphetto", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
